```yaml
name: Release CLI

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'cli/v*'

jobs:
  build-and-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: go mod tidy

    - name: Build binaries
      run: |
        GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 go build -o bin/browseros-darwin-amd64 ./cmd/browseros-cli
        GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -o bin/browseros-darwin-arm64 ./cmd/browseros-cli
        GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o bin/browseros-linux-amd64 ./cmd/browseros-cli
        GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -o bin/browseros-linux-arm64 ./cmd/browseros-cli
        GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -o bin/browseros-windows-amd64.exe ./cmd/browseros-cli

    - name: Run tests
      run: go test ./...

    - name: Create release
      id: create_release
      uses: actions/create-release@v1
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      with:
        tag_name: ${{ github.ref }}
        release_name: Release ${{ github.ref }}
        draft: false
        prerelease: false

    - name: Upload binaries
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: browseros-binaries
        path: bin/

    - name: Upload release assets
      uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      with:
        upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
        asset_path: bin/
        asset_name: browseros-binaries.tar.gz
        asset_content_type: application/gzip
```
